g.text: Choose the next accepted work productand the test that earns expansion
Bring representative questions; select one domain.Agree entity, metric and date definitions, withtrusted reference results.
Instrument stage latency and observe how repsprepare for an advisor meeting.
One count/forecast correctness fixture.One bound quantitative lead or callout.One numerical outcome oracle.
Then connect one workspace assignmentto a checked analytical result.
Accepted work is the unit of progress.
Compare quality, consequential failures, total human effort and full known cost.Record continue, revise or stop, with uncertainty visible. Agree owners, timing and thresholds together.
End of the core briefing • Four reference pages follow for cases, scorecards, implementation anchors and sources.
